candidate.rationale: Repair slice bounds: reject an interior surrogate start, and move an interior end backward one code unit before the surrogate pair so slices never end inside a pair; empty slice exactly at EOF remains allowed.

Fix exact-json-scoring mutation: compare parsed JSON structurally with isDeepStrictEqual (object member order irrelevant; array order, types, and member presence significant) while preserving export, response_not_text and invalid_json reasons, and exact_json_match only for equal parsed values.

Fix retention-tool-pair validation: require call IDs to be unique within each exchange and each tool result to match the assistant call at the same positional index (not mere membership), per cases.json requirements and examples; preserve export, masking, and unrelated behavior.

Repair retention-long-window mutation: require tool-call IDs to be unique within each exchange (Set size check) and require each tool result's tool_call_id to match the assistant call at the same positional index instead of mere membership, per README and evidence/cases.json requirements. Masking behavior, export, and validation error codes are unchanged.

Correct only the schema metadata: add the required schema_version are.patch-set-candidate/v1. Source, rationale intent, base tree digest, operation, path and file digest preserved exactly from the rejected proposal, whose only reported issue was patch-set.schema-version-invalid.

Repair retention-tool-pair validation per evidence requirements: tool call IDs must be unique within each exchange (reject duplicate IDs, cases-09/13), and each tool result must match the assistant call at the same positional index rather than by mere membership (cases-10/11/14/15). Valid ordered one-to-one pairs and the recent tail remain unchanged; masking still replaces only old result content and never mutates the input history.
Compare parsed JSON structurally with isDeepStrictEqual instead of string comparison, preserving response_not_text/invalid_json reasons and only reporting exact_json_match for equal parsed values.

Repair archive-slice-bounds start-boundary mutation: reject an offset that begins inside a surrogate pair (low surrogate start), while keeping the existing end-boundary pullback before pairs, the no-progress rejection, and the empty-slice-at-EOF allowance. Exports and return fields unchanged.
Repair slice bounds: reject an interior surrogate-pair start, and move an interior end backward before the pair; keep the no-progress rejection for nonempty reads that would split a pair.

Structural JSON comparison: key order in objects is not significant, while array order, value types, and missing/extra members remain significant. isDeepStrictEqual on the parsed values satisfies this; response_not_text and invalid_json reasons and the public export are preserved.

Repair retention-long-window mutation: require call IDs to be unique within each exchange (Set size check) and each tool result to match the assistant call at the same positional index (ids[index]) instead of membership only, per cases.json requirements and example interpretations. Unrelated behavior and exports preserved.
